items.description: Analyze repository structure and setup baseline project folders
items.acceptance_criteria: Document listing all major modules, setup of `results/`, `src/`, and `lit_review/` directories.

items.description: Delegate literature review of R(5,5) state-of-the-art to subagent to identify novel methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Subagent returns a synthesis of at least 5 non-standard approaches (e.g., RL, algebraic, physics-inspired) to Ramsey bounds.

items.description: Conduct web search for SOTA approaches and create/maintain sources.bib in the repo root
items.acceptance_criteria: At least 10 relevant papers cited in `sources.bib` covering non-computational/novel methods for Ramsey numbers.

items.description: Explore concept trees for novel methods in results/concept_evolve/tree/
items.acceptance_criteria: Markdown file `results/concept_evolve/tree/ramsey_methods.md` showing a hierarchical concept map of novel approaches.

items.description: Formulate the core research problem mathematically using 2 non-traditional approaches
items.acceptance_criteria: A formal problem statement document detailing the 2 selected approaches (e.g., AlphaZero-style RL and Continuous Optimization).

items.description: Delegate baseline implementation of K5-freeness graph verification to subagent
items.acceptance_criteria: Subagent delivers unit-tested Python module `src/baseline/verifier.py` for efficient clique/independent set checking.

items.description: Implement existing SAT encoding baseline for R(5,5) up to n=42
items.acceptance_criteria: Working SAT generator and solver script `src/baseline/sat_baseline.py` that can construct R(5,5,42) graphs or prove unsatisfiability.

items.description: Develop a continuous relaxation of the K5-freeness objective function
items.acceptance_criteria: Python module `src/core/continuous_loss.py` implementing a differentiable loss function for graph adjacency matrices.

items.description: Set up metric tracking and logging framework to compare novel approaches
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/metrics.json` schema defined and integration code in `src/utils/logger.py`.

items.description: Document and unit-test the baseline metrics and graph evaluation pipelines
items.acceptance_criteria: Pytest suite passes with >90% coverage on `src/baseline/` and `src/utils/`.

items.description: Design and implement a GNN actor-critic RL environment
items.acceptance_criteria: RL environment `src/core/rl_env.py` using Gym/PettingZoo API with GNN state embeddings to construct R(5,5) graphs.

items.description: Delegate exploration of advanced symmetry-breaking algebraic constructions to subagent
items.acceptance_criteria: Subagent provides a mathematical report and Python generator `src/core/algebraic_gen.py` for candidate graphs.

items.description: Design an optimization pipeline using continuous flag algebras
items.acceptance_criteria: SDP formulation script `src/core/flag_algebras.py` that interfaces with Mosek or SCS to tighten the upper bound.

items.description: Synthesize the GNN and algebraic methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Integrated model `src/core/unified_model.py` that uses GNNs to search over algebraic graph generators rather than adjacency matrices.

items.description: Log concept-tree evolution for the novel unified approach
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/concept_evolve/tree/unified_approach.md` detailing how RL and Algebraic methods were merged.

items.description: Delegate hyperparameter tuning and execution of the GNN-RL agent to subagent
items.acceptance_criteria: Subagent returns optimal hyperparameters and a trained model checkpoint in `results/models/` for n=43.

items.description: Run continuous flag algebra optimization
items.acceptance_criteria: SDP solver output logged in `results/flag_algebra_run.log` with formal dual bounds attempting to beat 48.

items.description: Compare novel GNN/Algebraic performance against traditional SAT baseline and prior work
items.acceptance_criteria: Comparative analysis report `results/baseline_comparison.md` referencing specific prior work from `sources.bib`.

items.description: Perform ablation studies on the GNN architecture and symmetry-breaking constraints
items.acceptance_criteria: Ablation results table in `results/metrics.json` showing the contribution of each algorithmic component.

items.description: Synthesize experimental results and generate plots/visualizations
items.acceptance_criteria: Figures saved in `figures/` directory (e.g., `learning_curve.png`, `graph_structure.pdf`).

items.description: Delegate final analysis of experimental results and literature comparison to subagent
items.acceptance_criteria: Subagent delivers a comprehensive results discussion section comparing findings to at least 3 papers from `sources.bib`.

items.description: Draft research paper sections based on experimental findings
items.acceptance_criteria: LaTeX files created in `docs/paper/` covering Introduction, Methods, Results, and Conclusion.

items.description: Extract newly discovered graph structures for n=43 and mathematically verify them
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/novel_graphs.txt` containing verified adjacency matrices or a formal proof of non-existence.

items.description: Format bibliography using sources.bib and ensure all claims are cited
items.acceptance_criteria: Compiled `paper.pdf` with no missing citations and correctly formatted references from `sources.bib` (minimum 10 citations).

items.description: Compile final research report and review against initial concept trees
items.acceptance_criteria: Final PDF generated and a retrospective document `results/concept_evolve/tree/retrospective.md` comparing initial plans to final outcomes.
